install_polygrasp_package: install the polygrasp package with pip using setup.py and all required dependencies
run_grasp_script: run the scripts/run_grasp.py script provided by the polygrasp package for grasping primitives
build_polygrasp_module: build a python module to install polygrasp with dependencies mrp, graspnetAPI, open3d, fairomsg, realsense_wrapper, and ikpy
review_setup_dependencies: review the polygrasp setup.py install_requires dependencies list for missing or outdated packages
refactor_setup_ik_dependency: refactor the polygrasp setup.py to switch from ikpy to a better inverse kinematics library
